sentence: This project builds methods to make extracellular vesicles in large quantities and to measure them in a consistent way.
This project builds an online tool that uses generative AI and virtual reality labs to teach cybersecurity, with lessons matched to learning needs.
This project studies why ultrahigh-strength steels lose toughness during high-rate impact and how features inside them lead to cracks.
This project builds fast computational methods to solve equations that describe wave phenomena in complex geometries, including ones with edges and corners.
This project builds automated tools that use data provenance to detect and respond to stealthy cyber threats in data centers.
This project builds machine learning methods to explore complex biomedical data and explain the regulatory mechanisms that drive disease.
This project builds training modules that show how artificial intelligence tools can help with threat detection, digital forensics and incident investigation.
This project studies how genetic variety and environmental conditions affect the adaptation and persistence of a rare, threatened shrub.
This project uses deep learning guided by physics to study how nitrate, total phosphorus and turbidity in rivers change across the United States.
This project builds a computer memory device by placing magnetic molecules between two magnetic layers to control electron movement.
This project builds a low-cost system that uses artificial intelligence to plan inspection routes and to detect distress in road images.
This project builds artificial intelligence models to predict where storms will initially form and how uncertain those predictions are.
This project builds a bio-inspired device that turns tire vibrations into electricity to power sensing and communication in smart tires.
This project studies how a protein involved in nitric oxide signaling is recognized by a nuclear import receptor and enters the nucleus.
This project uses probability theory to build a mathematical framework for embedding theorems and to connect them with deep learning and turbulence in fluids.
This project builds a cyber range that gives hands-on experience with live fire cyberattacks in a safe training environment.
This project builds deep learning modules with lecture slides, demos and hands-on labs for existing computer science and engineering classes.
This project builds a mathematical theory to explain when and why neural collapse happens in deep learning and how it relates to generalization.
